notes.content: Name is Alex; works as a software developer focused on Python and machine learning.
Loves Python and machine learning; Python is the primary programming language and preferred ML tooling is Python-centric.

Says he switched from PyTorch to JAX for better performance and prefers JAX-first tooling (Flax/NNX or Equinox, Optax, Orbax, Grain, jax.sharding) and functional JAX idioms (jit, vmap, explicit PRNG keys). Note: he has also said his current recsys project uses PyTorch, so clarify which framework is active before framework-specific advice.

Is building a recommendation system project; interested in two-tower retrieval, ranking models, negative sampling, and ranking evaluation metrics (Recall@K, NDCG@K), plus tooling/stack recommendations. Framework for this project is inconsistent across sessions (see framework note).
Prefers dark themes in their IDE.
Always uses type hints in Python code; wants code examples written with type annotations.

Framework ambiguity (still unresolved): Alex said he switched from PyTorch to JAX for performance, yet in multiple sessions — including the two most recent ones — he described his recommendation system project as "using PyTorch." Treat the project as PyTorch-based unless he says otherwise, while acknowledging his stated JAX/performance interest; ask which framework is active before framework-specific advice and be ready to give both PyTorch and JAX-idiomatic versions.

Frequently asks "What do you remember about my work and preferences?" — values explicit recall of his stored profile; proactively summarize what's remembered and confirm/refresh details when relevant.
